title: Voz pasiva en informes
explanation: Se usa para describir procesos o resultados sin decir quién lo hizo — muy común en informes técnicos y actualizaciones de proyecto.
examples: The samples were tested last week.
Three formulations have been developed so far.
The report will be sent by Friday.
exercisePrompt: Transforma a voz pasiva: "Alguien probó las muestras ayer."
exerciseAnswer: The samples were tested yesterday.

title: Estilo indirecto (reported speech)
explanation: Sirve para trasladar en una reunión lo que dijo un cliente o compañero, sin citarlo literalmente.
examples: She said the order would arrive on Monday.
He told us the price had increased.
They mentioned they were considering other suppliers.
exercisePrompt: Pasa a estilo indirecto: El cliente dijo: "We need the samples by Friday."
exerciseAnswer: The client said they needed the samples by Friday.

title: Primer condicional
explanation: Para condiciones reales o probables en el futuro — muy útil al negociar plazos o condiciones.
examples: If the batch fails the test, we'll need to rework the formula.
We'll ship the order if the payment clears today.
If you send the data sheet, I'll review it this afternoon.
exercisePrompt: Completa: "If the client ___ (agree) to the new price, we ___ (start) production next week."
exerciseAnswer: agrees, we will start

title: Segundo condicional
explanation: Para situaciones hipotéticas o improbables en el presente/futuro — útil para plantear escenarios en una reunión.
examples: If we had a bigger budget, we would test more formulations.
I would call the supplier if I were you.
If the price dropped, we would order more.
exercisePrompt: Traduce: "Si tuviéramos más tiempo, probaríamos otra fórmula."
exerciseAnswer: If we had more time, we would test another formula.

title: Tercer condicional
explanation: Para hipótesis sobre el pasado (lo que habría pasado si...) — muy común al analizar errores o incidencias ya cerradas.
examples: If we had tested it earlier, we would have caught the issue.
She wouldn't have called if it hadn't been urgent.
If the shipment had left on time, it would have arrived by now.
exercisePrompt: Traduce: "Si hubiéramos revisado la ficha técnica, habríamos visto el error."
exerciseAnswer: If we had checked the data sheet, we would have seen the error.

title: Oraciones de relativo
explanation: Para añadir información sobre algo o alguien sin abrir una frase nueva — hace tu inglés menos entrecortado.
examples: The client who called yesterday wants a bigger discount.
This is the formula that failed the stability test.
The supplier whose prices increased is based in Germany.
exercisePrompt: Combina en una frase: "The batch failed. The batch was tested last week."
exerciseAnswer: The batch that was tested last week failed.

title: Deducción presente (must/might/can't)
explanation: Para expresar lo probable en el presente sin afirmar con certeza — clave para sonar natural especulando en una reunión.
examples: The line isn't ready, they must still be testing it.
She might be in another meeting.
That can't be right — the numbers don't add up.
exercisePrompt: Traduce: "Seguramente todavía están probando el lote."
exerciseAnswer: They must still be testing the batch.

title: Deducción pasada (must/might/can't + have)
explanation: La misma idea de deducción, pero sobre algo que ya pasó — muy usada al analizar qué pudo haber fallado.
examples: The batch must have failed during transport.
They might have missed the email.
He can't have seen the report yet.
exercisePrompt: Traduce: "No pueden haber probado todas las muestras tan rápido."
exerciseAnswer: They can't have tested all the samples that fast.

title: used to / would (hábitos pasados)
explanation: Para hablar de cómo se hacían las cosas antes, en contraste con ahora — útil al explicar procesos que han cambiado.
examples: We used to test everything manually before we got the new equipment.
He would always double-check the formula before sending it.
They didn't use to require a CoA for this ingredient.
exercisePrompt: Traduce: "Antes solíamos usar otro proveedor."
exerciseAnswer: We used to use a different supplier.

title: Comparativos avanzados (the more..., by far)
explanation: Para reforzar comparaciones de forma más natural que "very" o "more" sueltos.
examples: The more we test, the more confident we are in the formula.
This is by far the most stable version we've developed.
The sooner we confirm, the better.
exercisePrompt: Traduce: "Cuanto antes confirmemos el pedido, antes podremos enviarlo."
exerciseAnswer: The sooner we confirm the order, the sooner we can ship it.

title: Inversión enfática
explanation: Anteponer palabras como "Not only", "Never" o "Rarely" invierte el orden sujeto-verbo y da un tono más formal y enfático — muy C1.
examples: Not only did the batch fail, but the report was also late.
Never have we faced such a delay.
Rarely does a client change the spec this late.
exercisePrompt: Traduce con inversión: "No solo se retrasó el envío, sino que también llegó dañado."
exerciseAnswer: Not only was the shipment delayed, but it also arrived damaged.

title: Cleft sentences (It was... / What...)
explanation: Sirven para poner el foco en una parte concreta de la frase — muy útil para dejar clara la causa de un problema.
examples: It was the supplier who caused the delay.
What we need is a faster approval process.
It's the packaging that's causing the issue.
exercisePrompt: Traduce: "Lo que necesitamos es más tiempo para las pruebas."
exerciseAnswer: What we need is more time for testing.

title: Condicionales mixtos
explanation: Mezclan una condición pasada con una consecuencia presente (o viceversa) — muy natural al hablar de errores con efectos actuales.
examples: If we had tested it properly, we wouldn't be dealing with this now.
If she were more experienced, she would have caught the error.
If the formula were more stable, we wouldn't have had to recall it.
exercisePrompt: Traduce: "Si hubiéramos elegido otro proveedor, no tendríamos este problema ahora."
exerciseAnswer: If we had chosen a different supplier, we wouldn't have this problem now.

title: Oraciones de participio (Having.../Given that...)
explanation: Permiten condensar dos frases en una de forma elegante — suena mucho más fluido que encadenar "and" o "because".
examples: Having finished the stability tests, we can move to scale-up.
Given that the results are positive, we'll proceed with production.
Having reviewed the data, I think we're ready to launch.
exercisePrompt: Traduce: "Habiendo completado las pruebas, podemos pasar a la siguiente fase."
exerciseAnswer: Having completed the tests, we can move to the next phase.

title: Matización (hedging)
explanation: Frases para suavizar una opinión sin sonar tajante — imprescindible en negociación y feedback delicado.
examples: It could be argued that the price is too high for this market.
I'd tend to say the formula needs more work.
Arguably, this is our strongest product yet.
exercisePrompt: Traduce con matización: "Podría decirse que el precio es demasiado alto."
exerciseAnswer: It could be argued that the price is too high.

title: do/does/did enfático
explanation: Añadir "do/does/did" delante del verbo da énfasis a algo que se pone en duda — muy útil para defender algo con firmeza sin subir el tono.
examples: We do understand your concerns about the delay.
The formula did pass the stability test, despite the delay.
I did send the report yesterday.
exercisePrompt: Traduce con énfasis: "Sí que enviamos la muestra la semana pasada."
exerciseAnswer: We did send the sample last week.

title: Futuro perfecto y continuo
explanation: Para proyectar en qué punto estará algo en una fecha futura concreta — muy usado en reuniones de seguimiento de proyecto.
examples: By next month, we will have finished the stability testing.
This time next week, we'll be presenting the results to the client.
By the time you arrive, we'll have already started the meeting.
exercisePrompt: Traduce: "Para el viernes, habremos terminado el informe."
exerciseAnswer: By Friday, we will have finished the report.

title: wish / if only
explanation: Para expresar deseo o arrepentimiento sobre el presente o el pasado — útil para reconocer un fallo con matiz humano, no solo técnico.
examples: I wish we had tested this formula earlier.
If only the supplier had warned us about the delay.
I wish the price were lower.
exercisePrompt: Traduce: "Ojalá hubiéramos revisado esto antes."
exerciseAnswer: I wish we had reviewed this earlier.

title: Causativo (have/get something done)
explanation: Para expresar que otra persona o empresa hace algo por encargo tuyo — frecuente al hablar de laboratorios externos o subcontratas.
examples: We had the samples tested by an external lab.
They got the packaging redesigned last quarter.
We need to have this formula approved before launch.
exercisePrompt: Traduce: "Vamos a hacer que analicen las muestras externamente."
exerciseAnswer: We are going to have the samples analyzed externally.

title: Marcadores de discurso avanzados
explanation: Conectores como "That being said" o "Notwithstanding" dan un tono más formal y estructurado a tus intervenciones.
examples: That being said, we still need to confirm the timeline.
Having said that, the client seemed satisfied with the proposal.
Notwithstanding the delay, the quality remained consistent.
exercisePrompt: Traduce: "Dicho esto, seguimos necesitando confirmar el plazo."
exerciseAnswer: That being said, we still need to confirm the deadline.
